title: Listening Drill — Swimming gala brief
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Swimming gala brief
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about the swimming gala. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns team registration.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the pool entrance. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the sports hall instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to Tara rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, check your lane number on the board. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
